verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents its own native SDKs for iOS and Android, plus an embeddable hosted web verification flow and APIs, so official SDKs exist. The evidence covers only mobile capture SDKs; backend/server-language SDKs are not shown, and no published OpenAPI spec was found (the probe returned 404). Missing for 10: server-side language SDKs (e.g. Python/Node), SDK reference docs with versioning, an OpenAPI spec for generated clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Integrate verification into iOS and Android apps with native SDKs optimized for mobile capture and performance
Embed user or business verification directly in your web applications with a fully hosted, customizable flow
